dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior limit of the frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light-grey with a slight lavender-blue hue; significantly lighter than slate-grey but not mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the subtly darker mid-dorsal line and the lighter lateral planes.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Series of dark, thin, parallel linear marks (rake-like scratches) on the posterior right dorsal quadrant; minor white punctate marks on the posterior left.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple thin, dark-pigmented linear marks on the lower right portion of the visible dorsal area, consistent with epidermal abrasions or rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Open and clearly defined blowhole at the anterior-most visible point of the dorsal plane.
